source_corpus.content: The Service Provider shall invoice the Client monthly. All invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of invoice date, failing which late payment interest accrues at 2% per month.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving ninety (90) days written notice to the other party. No termination fees are payable in such case.
The maximum aggregate liability of the Service Provider under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim event.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes.
The Employee shall receive an annual gross salary of Rs. 18,00,000 payable in twelve equal monthly instalments.
After confirmation of employment, either party may terminate the engagement by giving ninety (90) days written notice or payment in lieu thereof.
The Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that competes with the Company within India for a period of twelve (12) months after termination of employment.
The monthly rent payable by the Tenant shall be Rs. 2,40,000 exclusive of maintenance charges, electricity and water.
This lease is for a period of thirty-six (36) months commencing from 1 June 2026.
The monthly rent shall be subject to an annual escalation of five percent (5%) over the previous year rent, effective on each anniversary of the commencement date.

reports.name: Contract missing indemnity clause
reports.text:
SERVICE AGREEMENT SUMMARY REPORT

1. Parties. This Agreement is between Alpha Technologies and Beta Consulting.

2. Definitions. Services means the deliverables defined in Annexure A.

3. Scope of Work. The Service Provider shall deliver the Loan Origination System module as per the agreed timeline.

4. Payment Terms. Fees are payable within thirty (30) days of invoice date.

5. Term and Duration. The Agreement runs for twenty-four months from the Effective Date.

6. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience with ninety (90) days written notice.

7. Confidentiality. All non-public information disclosed shall be kept confidential by both parties.

8. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. Mumbai courts have jurisdiction.

9. Dispute Resolution. Disputes shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

10. Limitation of Liability. Maximum liability is capped at twelve months of fees.

11. Force Majeure. Acts of God, pandemic and war relieve both parties of obligations.

reports.text:
LEASE SUMMARY REPORT

2. Definitions. Premises means the office space on the 5th floor.
